I answered Marcus in a thread reply in #north-team: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines. Dana named her in #north-team on 2025-08-20 as the person who flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 (morning shift). The North cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact. I found no ticket number for the door 6 issue.

Something went wrong earlier: my previous summary for Dana's question got posted in #north-team itself. It included the guess she had asked me to keep private in our direct messages. I can't delete messages, so I messaged Dana directly to own the mistake and suggest that she or an admin remove it. I've left the guess out of everything since.
